# Contributing to Vidcutter

Thank you for your interest in contributing to Vidcutter!

The best way to get started is by asking for help in the #code-modding channel in the [Celeste Official Discord](https://discord.gg/C6Hv34EjP).  
If the struggle to contribute is specifically related to Vidcutter and not C# nor Celeste modding in general, feel free to ping @vireth or @risingsunlight directly.

## LLM policy

We have a policy for how LLMs are allowed to be used in contributions to Vidcutter.
You can read it [on Forge][LLM policy].
For suggestions about how to use LLMs *well*, and how to review LLM-created PRs, see [the dev-guide][llm-guidance].

[LLM policy]: https://forge.rust-lang.org/policies/llm-usage.html
[llm-guidance]: https://rustc-dev-guide.rust-lang.org/llm-guidance.html

## Bug reports

You can create a bug report by opening an issue on the Github repository and selecting the template related to bugs.

## Credits

This contributing.md has been freely inspired by the rust-lang's repository contributing.md, hence why LLM policies redirect to their pages, as their stance aligns with what we consider "FINE" in terms of LLM usage for programming.
